Name: Lemuel
Summary: Lemuel was a king whose words make up Proverbs 31, recording the teaching his mother gave him — including the famous portrait of the virtuous woman.
KeyStory: King Lemuel's oracle warns kings against wine and injustice, and praises the woman who fears the Lord, whose worth is far above rubies.
LifeLesson: Lemuel shows that the best royal wisdom is often learned at home — a mother's teaching, kept and passed on.
